messages:
alex-cs: FYI we9ve got a spike of onboarding/import failures starting ~02:00 UTC. ~12 tenants hit 429s on /v1/tenant/batch_create during bulk imports. A few are high-touch trials; some renewal risk. Need quick customer comms + mitigation plan.
priya-cs: What9s the user impact? Are imports retrying successfully later? Any >=$10k accounts affected?
alex-cs: Most imports are stuck; clients see retries that eventually give up. 3 tenants reported webhooks failing. Logs: `HTTP 429: rate_limited - token_quota_exceeded` and a handful of `503` from embeddings upstream. Sheet coming.
toni-eng: Investigating. Likely autoscaler oscillation + large synchronous imports caused cache churn and capacity pressure. Rolling a soft rate bump + per-tenant rate isolation. Patch rollout ETA 30-45m.
derek-ops: Queued large imports into a low-concurrency background worker to reduce pressure. Rolling restart of batch workers in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 started.
alex-cs: We need: (1) short status update for affected tenants in next 20m, (2) reconciliation + credit offer. Draft below, edit pls.
---
Hi — we9re sorry for the disruption. We9re investigating errors affecting bulk onboarding/imports that can cause import jobs to fail with "rate limit" errors. Engineers have identified the root cause and are rolling a fix; we expect recovery in 45–60 minutes.
What we9re doing now: reducing import concurrency, restarting batch workers, and enabling temporary per-account rate isolation.
Next steps: we9ll follow up with a detailed RCA and a complimentary account credit to make this right. If you need hands-on help to complete your import, reply and we9ll prioritize a support session.
— Redwood Inference (Customer Success)
---
priya-cs: Looks good. Add an exact ETA window and a contact link. Recommend offering a tailored onboarding session + 15% credit for failed migrations for high-touch customers.
sarah-cs: I9ll triage the impacted list and start outreach for top 6 accounts by ARR. Intercom + direct email + calendar links. Assigning to me.
alex-cs: Action items:
- sarah-cs: outbound to impacted customers and schedule priority sessions for top accounts.
- priya-cs: finalize customer message with ETA + contact link and publish in 20m.
- toni-eng: confirm when patch hits prod and report residual 429s.
- derek-ops: prepare provisional credits; billing will finalize after verification.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-28345 created, assigned to eng-oncall (toni-eng).
derek-ops: Confirmed credits workflow: we can provision provisional credits now; finalization after impact verification.
toni-eng: Patch at ~50% rollout — early telemetry shows ~70% reduction in 429s for the route. Monitoring cache eviction and latency.
alex-cs: Good. After status blast, collect customer replies and import logs into the incident sheet: http://redwood.internal/onboard-incident-28345 — sarah will own mapping to credits.
sarah-cs: On it. Will DM legal if anyone escalates SLA/contract concerns. Posting outreach snippets here once done.
priya-cs: I9ll draft the RCA outline while we watch. Tentative cause: simultaneous heavy imports + autoscaler lag + KV/prefix cache churn leading to token quota exhaustion.
alex-cs: Thanks. Priority is to reduce customer noise. We9ll reconvene here after patch completion for RCA and remediation planning. :thumbsup:
